text: Objective: This project is undertaken by School of Economics of WUT. It aims at training students abilities of research and application in fields like Economic Development, Industrial Organization, International Trade, Investment, Environment and Resources and Financial Management.The team of teachers is composed of professors graduate from distinguished universities in Europe and USA (such as Yale University and Oxford University). They are all experienced in teaching and direction international students. Distinguished Nobel Prize winners –Professore Robert A. Mundell from Columbia University and Professor Clive W.F.Granger both came to the school of Economics to give lectures. Research Orientation: Industrial organizations and enterprises competition, development strategy and planning of regional economies, international investigation and management of multinational companies, financial innovation and financial engineering, as well as environmental and resource economics
